rationale: The stock gapped down ~13% on mixed earnings (revenue beat, EPS miss, declining average order value) and has since recovered significantly from the low of $17.93 to $20.88, placing it at 73% of today's range. Price is now below both the 9-EMA ($21.14) and VWAP ($20.99) with the last few candles showing slight drift lower on thin volume, suggesting the recovery momentum is fading but no clear directional conviction exists. The spread is wide at ~48 bps, the stock is in a post-earnings digestion phase with conflicting signals, and the risk/reward for either direction is unclear at this mid-range position.
